subject.title: fix(agents): honest degraded message when tools succeed but final response is empty

question: Should this PR land as a narrow truthful-fallback improvement while the broader guarded-finalizer work remains open in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/111764?
rationale: The patch is internally coherent, but the linked report describes a stronger behavioral recovery path; only maintainers can decide whether the message-only improvement is acceptable as separate scope.

options.title: Land as a narrow fallback fix
options.body: Replace the closing relationship with a non-closing reference and keep the linked issue open for the guarded finalizer retry.

options.title: Expand this PR
options.body: Implement and prove the single guarded no-tool finalizer retry before treating it as the fix for the linked report.

options.title: Hold for issue direction
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers decide whether a degraded message without retry meets the desired agent-recovery behavior.

recommendation.title: Land as a narrow fallback fix
recommendation.body: Replace the closing relationship with a non-closing reference and keep the linked issue open for the guarded finalizer retry.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the concrete production trace and expected recovery behavior, though maintainer ownership still needs confirmation.
